name: SimpleBusinessBots Chat
author: simplebusinessbots

sections.description:
SimpleBusinessBots Chat adds an AI chatbot to your WordPress or WooCommerce site. The bot answers customer questions based on your actual business information (products, services, pricing, hours, and FAQ) so visitors get helpful answers 24/7 without you being online. On WooCommerce sites, it also answers live inventory questions: what’s in stock, prices, and product details.

Why SimpleBusinessBots:

  • One flat monthly fee. No OpenAI or Claude account to set up, no API keys to manage, no token bills to track. We handle the AI infrastructure.
  • No message caps or “agent actions” limits. Other plugins charge a low headline fee then meter every reply, or cap you at a few hundred messages a month. We don’t.
  • Predictable quality. Our prompts are tuned to one specific AI model, so the bot’s tone, lead capture, and conversation flow stay consistent. Switching providers (which BYOK plugins force you to think about) isn’t your problem.

How it works:

  1. Sign up at simplebusinessbots.com. We scan your website and build your bot in under 2 minutes
  2. Install this plugin and enter your Business ID
  3. Your chatbot widget appears on your site immediately

Features:

  • AI chatbot trained on your website content
  • Lead capture: collects visitor name, phone, and email
  • Instant email notifications when leads are captured
  • Live chat: join conversations in real time (Premium)
  • Owner mobile app (PWA): get push notifications when leads come in, review activity, and join live chats from your phone
  • Weekly performance reports
  • 12 CRM and marketing integrations (HubSpot, Mailchimp, Zapier, Google Calendar, and more)
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • WooCommerce compatible: answers product and inventory questions
  • Mobile responsive widget
  • No coding required

Pricing:

  • Basic: $29/month
  • Growth: $49/month
  • Premium: $79/month

See all features and pricing at simplebusinessbots.com.

Integrations:

Connect your chatbot to the tools you already use: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Zapier, Make, WhatsApp, Clio, Follow Up Boss, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory, or upload the simplebusinessbots-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings > SimpleBusinessBots Chat
  4. Enter your Business ID (found in your owner dashboard or welcome email)
  5. Your chatbot widget will appear on your site

Don’t have an account? Sign up at simplebusinessbots.com to get started.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SimpleBusinessBots account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the SimpleBusinessBots service. Sign up at simplebusinessbots.com to create your chatbot — the plugin then adds the widget to your site.

Where do I find my Business ID?

Your Business ID is in your owner dashboard under Settings > Install Code, or in your welcome email. It looks like your-business-name-com.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The chatbot can answer questions about your WooCommerce products, pricing, and stock availability when inventory sync is enabled in your dashboard.

Can I customize the chatbot?

Yes. You can customize the widget color, greeting message, tone, conversation style, and more from your owner dashboard at simplebusinessbots.com.

What data does the plugin collect?

This plugin itself collects no data. It loads a chat widget from simplebusinessbots.com which processes chat messages through the SimpleBusinessBots service. See our Privacy Policy for details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added a clearer “Start your free trial” call-to-action on the settings page when no Business ID is configured yet — explains the next step for plugin users who don’t have an account.
  • Added attribution parameters (UTM) to the signup and dashboard links so traffic from this plugin can be measured. No data leaves WordPress; the parameters only attach when an admin clicks through to simplebusinessbots.com.
  • No changes to the chat widget behavior.

1.0.1

  • Renamed all internal identifiers (functions, define, option names, settings group, script handle) from the sbb_ / SBB_ / sbb- prefix to sbbchat_ / SBBCHAT_ / sbbchat- to meet WordPress.org’s 4+ character prefix requirement and avoid collisions with other plugins.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Settings page for Business ID
  • Automatic widget injection
  • Settings link on Plugins page
